in_marathi.name: Bhupen
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhupen हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhupen is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Lord of the Earth'. This name is rooted in Hindu mythology and symbolizes strength, stability, and a deep connection to the natural world.
